about: Zenkai Z1 intent examples for the night-3 harness fixes (evaluator only). Each example is a REAL recorded night3-20261108 case (distilled in gauntlet/tests/fixtures/night3_cases.json) with an optional mutation that makes the SAME shape a real failure. Z2: oracle A states the raw facts (what the envelope claimed and what the sidecar holds); oracle B is gauntlet.evaluate.evaluate().
subject: gauntlet/evaluate.py::_before_value (absent-module before), _honest_final_step (reported asks the failing step), _nested_codes/_transient_block (nested transient codes)

examples.source: S1a: say ok 0.0 -> 0.05, sidecar 0.05, frame re-staged clean so before has no colorbalancergb
guard: the same envelope with a sidecar that disagrees
guard: an empty before snapshot is unreadable, not module-absent
S2b: stronger ok, weaker partial with a nested transient refusal; the user was told the truth
guard: the first step said ok and the sidecar never got it
group B: transient refusal nested in a say partial
